purpose: Initial scan-screen design candidates only. No application source or build changes.

candidates.name: 기존 Unity형
candidates.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Edit target: the attached screenshot of the actual Painting Workstation initial scan screen. Create one high-fidelity desktop APPLICATION design candidate, as a flat full-window UI screenshot, wide landscape 16:10, high resolution. Not a website hero, not a slide, not a collage, not a photograph of a computer. This is the first launch BEFORE scan data or trajectories have been loaded.
Preserve the functional content and engineering scene from the reference: the silver-gray 7 by 4 by 3 metre overhead gantry with columns, rail carriage and a single white six-axis robot, seen from the same elevated isometric angle on a floor grid. Six thin translucent rectangular PART PLACEMENT placeholders, three per side; selected left first position is blue, others subdued; small yellow scan-direction arrows. Do not add a car, door, scanner feed or painted path. These are layout previews, NOT actual robot execution.
Required content: title "Painting Workstation"; four process stages "1 스캔", "2 도장 경로 생성", "3 도장 경로 수정", "4 모션 플래닝" with ONLY stage 1 active, no completed checkmarks. A usable large 3D viewport must dominate. Left view controls: "표시 항목", "갠트리 · 로봇", "좌표축", "화면 설정", "배경", "조명 밝기". Right scan setup has two tabs "부품 배치", "스캔 파일", first active. Six presets clearly arranged as two rows: "왼쪽 1", "왼쪽 2", "왼쪽 3"; "오른쪽 1", "오른쪽 2", "오른쪽 3". Selected 왼쪽 1. Small "+ 위치 추가" action. Fields "위치 · mm" X -2000, Y 1200, Z 1200; "회전 · deg" R 90, P 0, Y 0; "스캔 방향" X 0, Y 1, Z 0. Bottom secondary "배치 저장", primary "다음: 도장 경로 생성". Short status "배치 미리보기 · 장비 제어 없음". View buttons "전체 보기", "위에서". Practical readable Korean typography with exact short labels, labels around 14px equivalent, headings 18-20px. No dense paragraphs. No duplicate actions. No "Scan now" or unsafe motion button. Avoid gradients, neon, excessive blur, decorative charts, generic SaaS statistics, fake brand logos, social media content. Every input and button fits fully, no clipping. All panels must look implementable in React and Three.js. No browser URL bar or desktop dock.

DESIGN A — UNITY CLASSIC. Retain the user's older familiar professional editor look, deliberately different from a rounded SaaS redesign. Squared flush docked panels with 1px separators, neutral charcoal #252525 panels, medium gray #333333 section headers, dark #191c20 viewport. Very subtle near-square 2px corners only. Compact but readable 14px labels, standard Windows desktop tool controls, 13px monospaced numeric values. Layout: 220px left scene hierarchy/settings, huge central viewport, 345px full-height right Inspector. Header uses four contiguous classic chevron-shaped workflow tabs with blue underline and stage number for selected scan stage. Small functional titlebar app name, right top label "Inspector". Right property inputs in tight aligned horizontal rows, numeric XYZ side-by-side, no floating cards. Optional small scene tree entries for gantry and robot. Blue #3f7fb1 used ONLY for active stage, chosen preset and next button. Strong grouping through flat section header strips, not borders around every group. Familiar Unity-inspired industrial engineering workstation, sober and detailed but uncluttered. Preserve reference gantry geometry and orientation exactly as far as possible.

DESIGN B — CAD PRECISION. A polished high-end mechanical CAD application, DIFFERENT from both Unity and rounded social-app styling. Use a warm light-gray #e7e9ec compact top command ribbon and pale #f3f4f5 docking sidebars with near-black technical text; center viewport remains slate gray #303a45 so silver gantry is very clear. Tightly aligned linear sections and slim borders, squared 3px corners, no puffy cards. Left sidebar 200px, center 65% width, right properties 310px. Workflow is an understated single top tab bar with a thin cobalt-blue underline on "1 스캔", inactive tabs clear gray. Left panel tree titled "장면"; visualization controls beneath. Top of viewport contains compact CAD view buttons and tiny XYZ orientation cube. Right panel header "스캔 설정"; tab "부품 배치" selected; six presets outlined rectangular chips and a neatly typeset engineering property inspector with labels on left and three numbers per row. Keep right fields compact with more visual space around gantry. Clear semibold section titles and restrained technical typography, balanced pale shell and darker modeling canvas. Primary action cobalt #2563b2, no saturated decorative surfaces. Preserve all fields and all six presets; preserve scene geometry. Looks like a real professional CAD desktop app at first launch, not a web dashboard.
